title: The question of Anderson and Ihara on the pro-p Galois action on the projective line minus three points, at every prime satisfying Vandiver's conjecture
subject: math.NT
abstract: Ihara showed that the kernel of the outer action of the absolute Galois group of $\mathbb Q$ on the pro-$p$ fundamental group of the projective line minus three points cuts out a field contained in the maximal pro-$p$ extension of $\mathbb Q(\mu_p)$ unramified outside $p$, and Anderson and Ihara asked whether the two fields are equal. Sharifi proved that they are equal at odd regular primes if the Deligne--Ihara conjecture holds, and Brown proved that conjecture. We prove the equality at every odd prime $p$ for which the plus part of the Iwasawa module of $p$-class groups of the cyclotomic tower is finite. This holds whenever $p$ does not divide the class number of the real cyclotomic field $\mathbb Q(\mu_p)^+$, which is Vandiver's conjecture at $p$; by the computation of Hart, Harvey and Ong the equality therefore holds at every odd prime below $2^{31}$. At an irregular prime the Galois group in question has generators that the regular case does not have. The theorems of Fukaya--Kato and Wake--Wang-Erickson on Sharifi's symbol map show that cup products of cyclotomic units generate the relevant second cohomology at every finite level, and we prove that this forces the images of the new generators to have poles that separate all words. The mathematics and the proofs were produced by GPT-6 Astra (ChatGPT Pro mode). Claude Opus 5.5 at effort high checked the deduction from Vandiver's conjecture and the present text of Sections 4 to 6 step by step, with the theorems of Fukaya--Kato and Wake--Wang-Erickson read at the places cited; Claude Fable 5.2 at effort max edited the text, wrote its first two sections and refereed Sections 3 to 6. No human has checked it.
comments:
Version 2 (24 November 2026): no statement or proof is changed. Locators corrected: Sharifi 2002 is cited in the numbering of arXiv:math/0104116v2 (Theorem 1, Lemma 4), and his 2019 sentence is on p. 221 of RIMS Kokyuroku 2120, pp. 220-227. New Remark 7.2: Kurihara's equivalence of Vandiver's conjecture with the absence of p-torsion in K_{4k}(Z); the unrefereed statement of Mok and Zheng (Hexagon 2611.00998) that K_{4m}(Z) = 0 for m <= 30 adds no prime to the theorem. New Remark 8.1: Ishii's analogue for CM elliptic curves (arXiv:2312.04196v3).

This note answers, at every prime satisfying Vandiver's conjecture, the question of G. Anderson and Y. Ihara (Ann. of Math. 128 (1988), p. 272, question (a)): whether the field cut out by the kernel of the pro-p outer Galois action on the fundamental group of the projective line minus three points is the maximal pro-p extension of Q(mu_p) unramified outside p. The inclusion is Ihara's. At odd regular primes the equality is R. Sharifi's theorem (2002) combined with F. Brown's proof of the Deligne-Ihara conjecture; Sharifi described the irregular case as an open question in 2019. The arithmetic input is published: Wake and Wang-Erickson proved that Vandiver's conjecture implies Sharifi's conjecture, and Fukaya and Kato turned it into the generation of H^2 by cup products of cyclotomic units. New here are the comparison of finite-level cup products with the class-two extension (Lemma 4.1) and the separation of Magnus coefficients by poles (Lemma 5.1).

Checks: Claude Opus 5.5 at effort high checked Sections 4-7 and did the literature search; Claude Fable 5.2 at effort max refereed Sections 3-6 independently before deposit; Claude Opus 5.5 at effort max checked Section 7. No human has checked the proofs. Records and checks: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/mathematics-workbenches/blob/main/works/WB-0006.md
